sloka: चन्द्रार्कतरुणाभासां नियुक्तां शिबिकां शुभाम् ।आस्थाय प्रययौ श्रीमान् भरत: सपरिच्छद: ॥ २.९२.३६॥
transliteration: candrārkataruṇābhāsāṁ niyuktāṁ śibikāṁ śubhām ।āsthāya prayayau śrīmān bharata: saparicchada: ॥ 2.92.36॥

translations.english: Magnanimous Bharata got into an auspicious palanquin of the splendour of the Sun and the Moon kept ready and proceeded amidst escorts.
